description: This app's downloads from each store's daily reports: first-time downloads (Google Play: new users) and updates for the last 30 days, against the 30 days before, with a value per day for 60 days. Also each store page's funnel: App Store impressions, product page views, downloads by source, conversion, sessions and deletions (from Apple's analytics reports, once a person has started them), and Play's store listing visitors and acquisitions by traffic source. For tokens of the workspace's owners, also Apple's proceeds and Google's earnings per currency and RevenueCat's numbers; anyone else's token gets downloads only. A store whose reports can't be read says what to set up (the App Store vendor number and a key role that can read sales, or the Play reports bucket and permission). Reports are daily, so answers are kept for hours.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask the stores again instead of using the kept answer.
